meta.name: brand-guidelines
meta.description: Applies Anthropic's official brand colors and typography to any sort of artifact that may benefit from having Anthropic's look-and-feel. Use it when brand colors or style guidelines, visual formatting, or company design standards apply.

copy.tagline: 为内容套用品牌色彩与排版规范
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要快速为文档或界面应用品牌视觉风格。
copy.tagline_en: Apply brand colors and typography to your content.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly apply brand visual style to documents or interfaces.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 当你在对话中生成文档、图表等作品时，Claude 会自动应用 Anthropic 官方品牌色（深色、浅色、橙色等）和字体（标题用 Poppins，正文用 Lora），让作品具有 Anthropic 的视觉风格。
howto.when: 当你要求 Claude 创建或美化任何需要品牌视觉风格的内容（如演示文稿、报告、图表）时触发。

say.text: 帮我做一个 Anthropic 风格的幻灯片。
say.note: Claude 会使用品牌色和字体生成幻灯片。

say.text: 给这段文字加上 Anthropic 的品牌配色。
say.note: Claude 会应用品牌色和字体样式。

howto.what_en: When you generate artifacts like documents or charts in conversation, Claude automatically applies Anthropic's official brand colors (dark, light, orange, etc.) and typography (Poppins for headings, Lora for body text) to give them Anthropic's visual identity.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask Claude to create or style any content that benefits from brand visual identity, such as presentations, reports, or charts.

say_en.note: Claude will use brand colors and fonts.

say_en.text: Apply Anthropic brand colors to this text.
say_en.note: Claude will apply brand colors and typography.
